stem.text: Which graph correctly shows the relative melting points of the elements Mg, Al, Si and P plotted against their relative electronegativities?

A.alt: Graph of melting point against electronegativity. Points: Mg low on the left, Al highest, Si mid, P lowest on the far right.

B.alt: Graph of melting point against electronegativity. Points: Mg lowest on the left, Al just right of Mg, Si highest, P lowest on the far right.

C.alt: Graph of melting point against electronegativity. Points: P lowest on the left, Si highest on the left, Al mid-height on the right, Mg slightly lower and further right.

D.alt: Graph of melting point against electronegativity. Points: P lowest on the left, Si just right of P, Al highest in the middle, Mg mid-height on the far right.
